title: Type-argument defaults, short explicit lists, the declared `collect` default, `Rhs = Self` on the `std.ops` operator traits, and `argument-count` for a type-argument list that is too long (Type-Argument Defaults TD1-TD10, Collect CO5) are not implemented

Bindings through supertraits (AT1), trait value types that bind associated types (AT2), the `ambiguous-associated-type` code for bindings (AT3) and projections (AT6), requirement keys that bind associated types (AT5), and the rejection of an unbound requirement key (AT7) are not implemented
The pipe operator `|>` and its `_` placeholder (Pipe PL3-PL16, Chaining Study CS2) are not implemented
Deferred features are rejected with generic or wrong diagnostics, not structured unsupported diagnostics

Strings STR1-STR8: `len` counting bytes, `s[i]` as a `u8`, the built-in `chars`, `char_indices`, `bytes`, and `slice` methods, the `index-out-of-bounds` slice panics, and the `Index` and `IndexSet` implementations of `List`, `Map`, and `string` are not implemented; the prototype still counts scalars and rejects string indexing
Method references `Type::name` and `value::name` (Method References MR1-MR4, MR6) are not implemented

The closure-backed data `Iterator[T]` with a private `step`, `Iterator::from_fn`, `map` and `fold`, and `for` over `Iterable` only (Chaining Study CS7-CS11), are not implemented: the prototype keeps the `Iterator` trait

The `@error` intrinsic (Error Conversion decision 10) and its batch 9, 11, and 13 codes, bounds, and scope (decisions 21-31) are not implemented: the prototype resolves `@error` as an ordinary decorator, so it derives no `Display`, `Error`, or `From`, and `@from` and `@source` are unknown names

The property-test API batch 12 (Testing PT2-PT7) and its batch 13 answers (Q5-Q8) are not implemented: generic `Choices.int` and `Choices.float`, `string(max_chars)`, `Choices.map`, the `examples` option, the per-case draw budget and its simplest values, the `Arbitrary` template with its recursive-variant rules, and the generic `arbitrary.with` fact
Embedding simplification cannot be fully exercised: the prototype compiles one module without trait imports, so trait availability is untested, and the fixtures need package roles
Visibility-aware member lookup cannot be exercised: the prototype compiles one module, so every own member is visible, and the fixtures need package roles
Generic `collect[C]` with `FromIterator` (Collect CO1-CO3, CO6) is not implemented
The trait-argument ownership fixture for a foreign trait argument needs package roles, which the prototype lacks
Typed derivation M29's per-trait Self-line warning needs a second package, and the prototype CLI has no package roles
The `disposed-file` runtime profile named in spec/conformance/README.md does not exist
An initialization group's statements are not interleaved: the package linker joins the group's modules by identity, so a read of a later-joined module's binding fails
The prototype has no pack operations, so `pack.map(` on a local named `pack` resolves as a method call
A script's top-level println needs the inferred script entry requirement row, which the prototype does not infer
